scope: ClayVerse MicroVM Kubernetes deployment source contract

observed_problem.description: The Kata deployment StatefulSet used serviceName=clayverse while the only clayverse Service was an ordinary client-facing Service rather than a headless governing Service. Kubernetes StatefulSet documentation requires a Headless Service for the StatefulSet network identity.
observed_problem.counterhypothesis: A single-replica workload might appear functional without relying on stable per-Pod DNS, but that does not satisfy the documented StatefulSet governing-service contract and would conflate client ingress with StatefulSet identity.

repair.law: Keep the client-facing clayverse Service and add a separate clayverse-headless Service with clusterIP=None; bind StatefulSet.spec.serviceName to clayverse-headless.
repair.parallel_fusion_note: Parallel main subsequently added non-root PVC fsGroup hardening while retaining the headless-Service repair and its focused regression. No duplicate deployment lane was created.

supporting_execution.source_identity_check: git hash-object of reconstructed current template matched GitHub blob 73f4dcf80f78fcb4d78e144e281758c194aff6df exactly
assertions: client clayverse Service is not headless
default-deny NetworkPolicy retains empty ingress and egress

go_unusual_experiment.reason: This user trigger exposes no shared immutable request/turn id and only minute-precision user-message timing to the worker; the canonical atomic lease protocol fails closed.

next_runtime_gate: Build the exact final EntityOS-bearing ClayVerse OCI image on an admitted isolated surface, then apply/execute the same accepted digest in the required Kata/equivalent guest-kernel envelope and prove Kubernetes/CNI/Tier-2 recovery behavior.
